Method of Attack: Ransomware operation involving stealing sensitive documents from victims' servers before encrypting them
Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks on victims' official websites if ransom demands are not met
Posting stolen data online on a data leak site or selling it to third-party data brokers
Use of compromised credentials and exploitation of recently patched security flaws in SonicWall products (e.g., CVE-2021-20016, CVE-2021-20021, CVE-2021-20022, CVE-2021-2002)
Use of a Linux variant targeting VMware's ESXi virtual machine platform to encrypt multiple servers simultaneously
